   111	/-- A property is Zariski-local at target if it is local at target in the Zariski topology. -/
   112	abbrev IsZariskiLocalAtTarget (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) :=
   113	  P.IsLocalAtTarget Scheme.zariskiPrecoverage
   114	
   115	namespace IsZariskiLocalAtTarget
   116	
   117	/--
   118	`P` is local at the target if
   119	1. `P` respects isomorphisms.
   120	2. If `P` holds for `f : X ⟶ Y`, then `P` holds for `f ∣_ U` for any `U`.
   121	3. If `P` holds for `f ∣_ U` for an open cover `U` of `Y`, then `P` holds for `f`.
   122	-/
   123	protected lemma mk' {P : MorphismProperty Scheme} [P.RespectsIso]
   124	    (restrict : ∀ {X Y : Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens), P f → P (f ∣_ U))
   125	    (of_sSup_eq_top :
   126	      ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {ι : Type u} (U : ι → Y.Opens), iSup U = ⊤ →
   127	        (∀ i, P (f ∣_ U i)) → P f) :
   128	    IsZariskiLocalAtTarget P := by
   129	  refine .mk_of_iff_of_zeroHypercover fun {X Y} f 𝒰 ↦ ?_
   130	  refine ⟨fun hf i ↦ (P.arrow_mk_iso_iff (morphismRestrictOpensRange _ _)).mp (restrict _ _ hf),
   131	    fun h ↦ ?_⟩
   132	  refine of_sSup_eq_top f _ (Scheme.OpenCover.iSup_opensRange <| .ulift 𝒰) ?_
   133	  exact fun i ↦ (P.arrow_mk_iso_iff (morphismRestrictOpensRange f _)).mpr (h _)
   134	
   135	variable {P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}} [IsZariskiLocalAtTarget P]
   136	  {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (𝒰 : Y.OpenCover)
   137	
   138	lemma of_isPullback {UX UY : Scheme.{u}} {iY : UY ⟶ Y} [IsOpenImmersion iY]
   139	    {iX : UX ⟶ X} {f' : UX ⟶ UY} (h : IsPullback iX f' f iY) (H : P f) : P f' :=
   140	  MorphismProperty.IsLocalAtTarget.of_isPullback (Y.affineCover.add iY) .none h H
   141	
   142	theorem restrict (hf : P f) (U : Y.Opens) : P (f ∣_ U) :=
   143	  of_isPullback (isPullback_morphismRestrict f U).flip hf
   144	
   145	lemma of_iSup_eq_top {ι} (U : ι → Y.Opens) (hU : iSup U = ⊤)
   146	    (H : ∀ i, P (f ∣_ U i)) : P f := by
   147	  refine (P.iff_of_zeroHypercover_target
   148	    (Y.openCoverOfIsOpenCover (s := Set.range U) Subtype.val (by ext; simp [← hU]))).mpr fun i ↦ ?_
   149	  obtain ⟨_, i, rfl⟩ := i
   150	  refine (P.arrow_mk_iso_iff (morphismRestrictOpensRange f _)).mp ?_
   151	  change P (f ∣_ (U i).ι.opensRange)
   152	  rw [Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
   153	  exact H i
   154	
   155	theorem iff_of_iSup_eq_top {ι} (U : ι → Y.Opens) (hU : iSup U = ⊤) :
   156	    P f ↔ ∀ i, P (f ∣_ U i) :=
   157	  ⟨fun H _ ↦ restrict H _, of_iSup_eq_top U hU⟩
   158	
   159	lemma of_openCover (H : ∀ i, P (𝒰.pullbackHom f i)) : P f := by
   160	  apply of_iSup_eq_top (fun i ↦ (𝒰.f i).opensRange) 𝒰.iSup_opensRange
   161	  exact fun i ↦ (P.arrow_mk_iso_iff (morphismRestrictOpensRange f _)).mpr (H i)
   162	
   163	theorem iff_of_openCover (𝒰 : Y.OpenCover) :
   164	    P f ↔ ∀ i, P (𝒰.pullbackHom f i) :=
   165	  ⟨fun H _ ↦ of_isPullback (.of_hasPullback _ _) H, of_openCover _⟩
   166	
   167	set_option backward.defeqAttrib.useBackward true in
   168	lemma of_range_subset_iSup [P.RespectsRight @IsOpenImmersion] {ι : Type*} (U : ι → Y.Opens)
   169	    (H : Set.range f ⊆ (⨆ i, U i : Y.Opens)) (hf : ∀ i, P (f ∣_ U i)) : P f := by
   170	  let g : X ⟶ (⨆ i, U i : Y.Opens) := IsOpenImmersion.lift (Scheme.Opens.ι _) f (by simpa using H)
   171	  rw [← IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac (⨆ i, U i).ι f (by simpa using H)]
   172	  apply MorphismProperty.RespectsRight.postcomp (Q := @IsOpenImmersion) _ inferInstance
   173	  rw [iff_of_iSup_eq_top (P := P) (U := fun i : ι ↦ (⨆ i, U i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ U i)]
   174	  · intro i
   175	    have heq : g ⁻¹ᵁ (⨆ i, U i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ U i = f ⁻¹ᵁ U i := by
   176	      change (g ≫ (⨆ i, U i).ι) ⁻¹ᵁ U i = _
   177	      simp [g]
   178	    let e : Arrow.mk (g ∣_ (⨆ i, U i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ U i) ≅ Arrow.mk (f ∣_ U i) :=
   179	        Arrow.isoMk (X.isoOfEq heq) (Scheme.Opens.isoOfLE (le_iSup U i)) <| by
   180	      simp [← CategoryTheory.cancel_mono (U i).ι, g]
   181	    rw [P.arrow_mk_iso_iff e]
   182	    exact hf i
   183	  apply (⨆ i, U i).ι.image_injective
   184	  dsimp
   185	  rw [Scheme.Hom.image_iSup, Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
   186	  simp [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, le_iSup U]
   187	
   188	lemma of_forall_exists_morphismRestrict (H : ∀ x, ∃ U : Y.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ P (f ∣_ U)) : P f := by
   189	  choose U hxU hU using H
   190	  refine IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_iSup_eq_top U (top_le_iff.mp fun x _ ↦ ?_) hU
   191	  simpa using ⟨x, hxU x⟩
   192	
   193	lemma of_forall_source_exists_preimage
   194	    [P.RespectsRight IsOpenImmersion] [P.HasOfPostcompProperty IsOpenImmersion]
   195	    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hX : ∀ x, ∃ (U : Y.Opens), f x ∈ U ∧ P ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ≫ f)) :
   196	    P f := by
   197	  choose U h₁ h₂ using hX
   198	  apply IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_range_subset_iSup U
   199	  · rintro y ⟨x, rfl⟩
   200	    simp only [Opens.coe_iSup, Set.mem_iUnion, SetLike.mem_coe]
   201	    exact ⟨x, h₁ x⟩
   202	  · intro x
   203	    exact P.of_postcomp (f ∣_ U x) (U x).ι (inferInstance : IsOpenImmersion _) (by simp [h₂])

   206	lemma coprodMap {X Y X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ X') (g : Y ⟶ Y') (hf : P f) (hg : P g) :
   207	    P (coprod.map f g) := by
   208	  refine IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_openCover (coprodOpenCover.{_, 0} _ _) ?_
   209	  rintro (⟨⟨⟩⟩ | ⟨⟨⟩⟩)
   210	  · rw [← MorphismProperty.cancel_left_of_respectsIso P
   211	      (isPullback_inl_inl_coprodMap f g).flip.isoPullback.hom]
   212	    convert! hf

     8	/-!
     9	# The standard affine chart of relative projective space
    10	
    11	This file constructs the standard chart `D_+(X_none)` of
    12	`P(Option n; S)` as the base change of Mathlib's affine chart
    13	`Proj.awayι`. The identification of its chart ring with a polynomial ring,
    14	and hence of this scheme with `A(n; S)`, is deliberately a separate algebraic
    15	step.
    16	-/
    17	
    18	open CategoryTheory Limits MvPolynomial
    19	
    20	noncomputable section
    21	
    22	universe u
    23	
    24	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    25	
    26	namespace ProjectiveSpace
    27	
    28	variable (n : Type u) (S : Scheme.{u})
    29	
    30	local notation3 "P[" n "]" =>
    31	  homogeneousSubmodule (Option n) (ULift ℤ)
    32	
    33	/-- The distinguished homogenizing coordinate has degree one. -/
    34	private lemma X_none_mem_deg_one :
    35	    (X none : MvPolynomial (Option n) (ULift.{u} ℤ)) ∈ P[n] 1 :=
    36	  isHomogeneous_X _ _
    37	
    38	/-- The standard `D_+(X_none)` chart of relative projective space. It is the
    39	pullback of the corresponding affine open of the integral `Proj` model. -/
    40	def affineChart : Scheme.{u} :=
    41	  pullback (toProjInt (Option n) S)
    42	    (Proj.awayι P[n] (X none) (X_none_mem_deg_one n) Nat.zero_lt_one)
    43	
    44	namespace affineChart
    45	
    46	/-- The inclusion of the standard chart into relative projective space. -/
    47	def incl : affineChart n S ⟶ ℙ(Option n; S) :=
    48	  pullback.fst (toProjInt (Option n) S)
    49	    (Proj.awayι P[n] (X none) (X_none_mem_deg_one n) Nat.zero_lt_one)
    50	
    51	instance : IsOpenImmersion (incl n S) := by
    52	  dsimp [incl]
    53	  exact MorphismProperty.pullback_fst _ _
    54	    (Proj.instIsOpenImmersionAwayι P[n] (X none)
    55	      (X_none_mem_deg_one n) Nat.zero_lt_one)
    56	
    57	/-- The chart inclusion followed by the integral-model projection is the
    58	other pullback projection followed by `Proj.awayι`. -/
    59	@[reassoc]
    60	theorem incl_toProjInt :
    61	    incl n S ≫ toProjInt (Option n) S =
    62	      pullback.snd (toProjInt (Option n) S)
    63	          (Proj.awayι P[n] (X none) (X_none_mem_deg_one n) Nat.zero_lt_one) ≫
    64	        Proj.awayι P[n] (X none) (X_none_mem_deg_one n) Nat.zero_lt_one :=
    65	  pullback.condition
    66	
    67	instance : (affineChart n S).CanonicallyOver S where
    68	  hom := incl n S ≫ (ℙ(Option n; S) ↘ S)
    69	
    70	@[simp]
    71	theorem over_eq : affineChart n S ↘ S = incl n S ≫ (ℙ(Option n; S) ↘ S) :=
    72	  rfl
    73	
    74	/-- The chart is exactly the inverse image of `D_+(X_none)` in the integral
    75	model. -/
    76	theorem opensRange_incl :
    77	    (incl n S).opensRange =
    78	      toProjInt (Option n) S ⁻¹ᵁ
    79	        Proj.basicOpen P[n] (X none) := by
    80	  change (pullback.fst (toProjInt (Option n) S)
    81	      (Proj.awayι P[n] (X none) (X_none_mem_deg_one n) Nat.zero_lt_one)).opensRange = _
    82	  rw [Scheme.Hom.opensRange_pullbackFst, Proj.opensRange_awayι]
    83	
    84	end affineChart
    85	
    86	end ProjectiveSpace
    87	
    88	end AlgebraicGeometry

    14	/-!
    15	# Finite-morphism embeddings
    16	
    17	This file supplies two pieces of the standard proof that finite morphisms are
    18	projective. Over an affine target, a finite morphism is a closed subscheme of
    19	finite-dimensional affine space. At the other end of the compactification
    20	argument, a proper immersion into projective space is already closed.
    21	
    22	The remaining geometric step is to place the affine embedding in a projective
    23	chart and globalize it over the target. These results isolate both sides of
    24	that step without adding a projectivity hypothesis.
    25	-/
    26	
    27	open CategoryTheory Limits MvPolynomial
    28	
    29	noncomputable section
    30	
    31	universe u
    32	
    33	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    34	
    35	namespace Scheme.Hom.IsProjective
    36	
    37	variable {X S : Scheme.{u}} {pi : X ⟶ S}
    38	
    39	/-- A proper morphism that factors through projective space by an immersion is
    40	projective. Properness makes the immersion closed. -/
    41	theorem of_isProper_of_immersion (hpi : IsProper pi) {n : Type u} [Finite n]
    42	    (i : X ⟶ ℙ(n; S)) (hi : IsImmersion i)
    43	    (hcomp : i ≫ (ℙ(n; S) ↘ S) = pi) : pi.IsProjective := by
    44	  letI : IsImmersion i := hi
    45	  haveI : IsProper (i ≫ (ℙ(n; S) ↘ S)) := hcomp ▸ hpi
    46	  haveI : IsProper i := IsProper.of_comp i (ℙ(n; S) ↘ S)
    47	  haveI : IsClosedImmersion i :=
    48	    (IsClosedImmersion.iff_isProper_and_mono (f := i)).mpr
    49	      ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
    50	  exact ⟨n, inferInstance, i, inferInstance, hcomp⟩
    51	
    52	end Scheme.Hom.IsProjective
    53	
    54	namespace IsFinite
    55	
    56	/-- A specified finite module-spanning family in the affine source ring
    57	defines a closed immersion into affine space over the base. This is the
    58	chosen-generator form of `exists_closedImmersion_affineSpace`, used when the
    59	generators on two base charts have already been aligned. -/
    60	theorem isClosedImmersion_homOfVector_of_span_eq_top
    61	    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffine X] [IsAffine Y]
    62	    {n : Type u} [Finite n] (a : n → Γ(X, ⊤))
    63	    (hspan :
    64	      letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(X, ⊤) := RingHom.toAlgebra f.appTop.hom
    65	      Submodule.span Γ(Y, ⊤) (Set.range a) = ⊤) :
    66	    IsClosedImmersion (AffineSpace.homOfVector f a) := by
    67	  classical
    68	  letI : Fintype n := Fintype.ofFinite n
    69	  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(X, ⊤) := RingHom.toAlgebra f.appTop.hom
    70	  let i : X ⟶ 𝔸(n; Y) := AffineSpace.homOfVector f a

     9	/-!
    10	# Projective coordinate charts
    11	
    12	This file gives the coordinate-level API for constructing morphisms from an
    13	affine scheme to the integral model of projective space. A coordinate family
    14	with one coordinate equal to `1` defines a morphism through the corresponding
    15	standard chart. Two such morphisms agree when their coordinate families differ
    16	by multiplication by a unit.
    17	
    18	The construction is deliberately independent of curves. It is the reusable
    19	gluing substrate for globalizing affine embeddings over the two standard
    20	charts of the projective line.
    21	-/

    38	    (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{u} ℤ ≃+* ℤ).toRingHom) c

    49	/-- A homogeneous polynomial of degree `m` scales by `lambda ^ m` when all

    51	theorem eval_smul_of_isHomogeneous [Finite J] (lambda : B) (c : J → B)

    53	    eval (fun i ↦ lambda * c i) p = lambda ^ m * eval c p := by
    54	  classical
    55	  letI := Fintype.ofFinite J
    56	  conv_lhs => rw [p.as_sum]
    57	  conv_rhs => rw [p.as_sum]
    58	  rw [map_sum, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    59	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d hd ↦ ?_
    60	  have hdeg : Finsupp.degree d = m := by
    61	    by_contra hne
    62	    exact (mem_support_iff.mp hd) (hp.coeff_eq_zero hne)
    63	  rw [eval_monomial, eval_monomial]
    64	  simp_rw [mul_pow]
    65	  rw [Finsupp.prod_mul]
    66	  have hpow : d.prod (fun _ e ↦ lambda ^ e) = lambda ^ m := by
    67	    rw [Finsupp.prod_fintype _ _ (fun _ ↦ pow_zero _),
    68	      Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, ← Finsupp.degree_eq_sum, hdeg]
    69	  rw [hpow]

    72	/-- The lift of a homogeneous-coordinate evaluation to the degree-zero
    73	localization at a homogeneous element whose image is a unit. -/
    74	def awayLift (f : MvPolynomial J (ULift.{u} ℤ))

    76	    Away (homogeneousSubmodule J (ULift.{u} ℤ)) f →+* B :=
    77	  (IsLocalization.Away.lift (S := Localization.Away f) f hu).comp
    78	    (algebraMap (Away (homogeneousSubmodule J (ULift.{u} ℤ)) f)
    79	      (Localization.Away f))

    84	    (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule J (ULift.{u} ℤ) e)
    85	    (psi : MvPolynomial J (ULift.{u} ℤ) →+* B)
    86	    (hu : IsUnit (psi f)) (n : ℕ) (a : MvPolynomial J (ULift.{u} ℤ))

    88	    awayLift f psi hu
    89	        (Away.mk (homogeneousSubmodule J (ULift.{u} ℤ)) hf n a ha) *
    90	      psi f ^ n = psi a := by
    91	  have hspec :
    92	      Localization.mk a (⟨f ^ n, n, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers f) *
    93	          algebraMap _ (Localization.Away f) (f ^ n) =
    94	        algebraMap _ (Localization.Away f) a := by
    95	    rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk'_apply]
    96	    exact IsLocalization.mk'_spec _ _ _
    97	  have hlift := congrArg (IsLocalization.Away.lift
    98	    (S := Localization.Away f) f hu) hspec
    99	  rw [map_mul, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq,
   100	    IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq] at hlift

   102	    awayLift f psi hu
   103	        (Away.mk (homogeneousSubmodule J (ULift.{u} ℤ)) hf n a ha) *
   104	      psi f ^ n =

   134	      awayLift f (r.comp psi) (by simpa using hu.map r) := by

    10	# Aligned generators for a finite map over two Laurent charts
    11	
    12	For a finite morphism C -> Y and Laurent chart data on Y, the two inverse
    13	images of the standard charts are affine. Their section rings are finite
    14	modules over the corresponding chart rings of Y.
    15	
    16	This file applies TwoChart.exists_uniform_twisted_generators to those two
    17	finite modules. It produces one positive twist and finite generating families
    18	whose restrictions agree up to the common Laurent transition factor. The
    19	result is stated entirely in the source section rings, in the exact form
    20	consumed by TwistedCoordinates.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	set_option autoImplicit false
    24	
    25	noncomputable section
    26	
    27	universe u
    28

    13	/-!
    14	# Relative projective space `ℙ(n; S)`
    15	
    16	Mathlib v4.31 has the absolute `Proj` of a ℕ-graded ring together with the
    17	properness package for `Proj.toSpecZero` (`ProjectiveSpectrum/Proper.lean`),
    18	but no relative projective space over an arbitrary base scheme.  Following the
    19	`AffineSpace` pattern (`Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/AffineSpace.lean`) and the
    20	encoding settled in inbox `I-0118` (comment `C-0002`), this file defines
    21	
    22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace n S` (notation `ℙ(n; S)`): the relative
    23	  projective space with homogeneous coordinates indexed by `n : Type u`, i.e.
    24	  the pullback of the integral model
    25	  `Proj ℤ[Xᵢ : i ∈ n] = Proj (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule n (ULift ℤ))`
    26	  along `S ⟶ ⊤_ Scheme`;
    27	* the structural morphism `ℙ(n; S) ↘ S` (a `CanonicallyOver` instance) with
    28	  `IsProper` (hence `IsSeparated`, `UniversallyClosed`, `LocallyOfFiniteType`,
    29	  `QuasiCompact`) derived by base change from the Mathlib instances on
    30	  `Proj.toSpecZero`;
    31	* functoriality `ProjectiveSpace.map` in the base and the base-change square
    32	  `ProjectiveSpace.isPullback_map`.
    33	
    34	The key observations making the transfer work: the degree-zero part of the
    35	homogeneous coordinate ring is the copy of `ULift ℤ` given by the constants
    36	(`MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule_zero`), so `Spec (𝒜 0)` is terminal and
    37	`terminal.from (Proj 𝒜)` factors as `Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜` followed by an
    38	isomorphism; and for finitely many variables the coordinate ring is of finite
    39	type over its degree-zero part, which is exactly the hypothesis of the Mathlib
    40	properness instances.
    41	
    42	Blueprint: `def:projective_space`, `lem:projective_space_proper`
    43	(`blueprint/src/chapters/Picard_QuotScheme.tex`).
    44	-/

events.text: The projectivity proof is now split, and the checkpoint hook is detecting worker files in flight. I’m taking a fresh private-index snapshot against one captured `HEAD` so I can distinguish those edits from the contaminated shared index without publishing or disturbing anyone’s work.

data.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
OLD=$("$HORIZON_GIT" rev-parse HEAD)
IDX=$(mktemp)
rm -f "$IDX"
trap '"'rm -f \""'$IDX"'"' EXIT
GIT_INDEX_FILE=\""'$IDX" "$HORIZON_GIT" read-tree "$OLD"
GIT_INDEX_FILE="$IDX" "$HORIZON_GIT" status --short --untracked-files=all
printf '"'OLD=%s\\n' \""'$OLD"'

theorem uniqueAlgEquiv_monomial [Unique σ] {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {r : R} :
    (MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv R σ) (MvPolynomial.monomial d r)
      = Polynomial.monomial (d default) r := by
  simp [Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial]

theorem uniqueAlgEquiv_symm_monomial [Unique σ] {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {r : R} :
    (MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv R σ).symm (Polynomial.monomial (d default) r)
      = MvPolynomial.monomial d r := by
  simp [MvPolynomial.monomial_eq]

/-- The coefficient of `X ^ n` in `uniqueAlgEquiv R σ P` is the coefficient of the unique
monomial of degree `n` in `P`. -/
theorem coeff_uniqueAlgEquiv [Unique σ] (P : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : ℕ) :
    (MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv R σ P : Polynomial R).coeff n =
      coeff (Finsupp.single default n) P := by
  induction P using induction_on' with
  | monomial d r =>
      rw [uniqueAlgEquiv_monomial, Finsupp.unique_single d]
      simp [Polynomial.coeff_monomial, MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial]
  | add P Q hP hQ =>
      simpa using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hP hQ

/-- The coefficient of a monomial in `(uniqueAlgEquiv R σ).symm P` is the coefficient of the
corresponding univariate monomial in `P`. -/
theorem coeff_uniqueAlgEquiv_symm [Unique σ] (P : Polynomial R) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    coeff d ((MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv R σ).symm P) = P.coeff (d default) := by
  rw [Finsupp.unique_single d, ← coeff_uniqueAlgEquiv R, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
    Finsupp.single_eq_same]

@[simps apply]
def renameEquiv (f : σ ≃ τ) : MvPolynomial σ R ≃ₐ[R] MvPolynomial τ R :=
  { rename f with

@[simp]

  AlgEquiv.ext (by simp)

@[simp]
theorem renameEquiv_symm (f : σ ≃ τ) : (renameEquiv R f).symm = renameEquiv R f.symm :=

@[simp]
theorem renameEquiv_trans (e : σ ≃ τ) (f : τ ≃ α) :

  AlgEquiv.ext (rename_rename e f)

end

    16	`Picard/ProjectiveMorphism.lean`; that refinement is universe-monomorphic because
    17	its Serre twist is built by the project-local sheaf gluing engine.

    28	/-- A morphism is projective if it admits a closed immersion into a
    29	finite-dimensional relative projective space over its target. -/
    30	def Scheme.Hom.IsProjective {X S : Scheme.{u}} (pi : X ⟶ S) : Prop :=
    31	  ∃ (n : Type u) (_ : Finite n) (i : X ⟶ ℙ(n; S)),
    32	    IsClosedImmersion i ∧ i ≫ (ℙ(n; S) ↘ S) = pi
    33

    38	/-- Projective morphisms are proper. -/
    39	theorem isProper (h : pi.IsProjective) : IsProper pi := by
    40	  obtain ⟨n, hn, i, hi, hcomp⟩ := h
    41	  letI : Finite n := hn
    42	  haveI := hi
    43	  rw [← hcomp]
    44	  infer_instance
    45	
    46	/-- Projective morphisms are locally of finite type. -/
    47	theorem locallyOfFiniteType (h : pi.IsProjective) : LocallyOfFiniteType pi :=
    48	  haveI := h.isProper
    49	  inferInstance
    50	
    51	/-- Projective morphisms are separated. -/
    52	theorem isSeparated (h : pi.IsProjective) : IsSeparated pi :=
    53	  haveI := h.isProper
    54	  inferInstance
    55	
    56	/-- Projective morphisms are universally closed. -/
    57	theorem universallyClosed (h : pi.IsProjective) : UniversallyClosed pi :=
    58	  haveI := h.isProper
    59	  inferInstance

    61	/-- A closed immersion into a projective scheme is projective. -/
    62	theorem comp_isClosedImmersion (h : pi.IsProjective) {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    63	    (j : Y ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j] : (j ≫ pi).IsProjective := by
    64	  obtain ⟨n, hn, i, hi, hcomp⟩ := h
    65	  letI : Finite n := hn
    66	  haveI := hi
    67	  exact ⟨n, hn, j ≫ i, inferInstance, by rw [Category.assoc, hcomp]⟩
    68	
    69	/-- The comparison morphism from the base-changed source to the corresponding
    70	base change of its ambient projective space. -/
    71	private def baseChangeLift {S' : Scheme.{u}} (g : S' ⟶ S) {n : Type u}
    72	    (i : X ⟶ ℙ(n; S)) (hcomp : i ≫ (ℙ(n; S) ↘ S) = pi) :
    73	    pullback pi g ⟶ ℙ(n; S') :=
    74	  (ProjectiveSpace.isPullback_map n g).lift
    75	    (pullback.fst pi g ≫ i) (pullback.snd pi g)
    76	    (by rw [Category.assoc, hcomp, pullback.condition])
    77	
    78	/-- Projective morphisms are stable under arbitrary base change. -/
    79	theorem baseChange (h : pi.IsProjective) {S' : Scheme.{u}} (g : S' ⟶ S) :
    80	    (pullback.snd pi g).IsProjective := by
    81	  obtain ⟨n, hn, i, hi, hcomp⟩ := h
    82	  letI : Finite n := hn
    83	  haveI := hi
    84	  refine ⟨n, hn, baseChangeLift g i hcomp, ?_, ?_⟩
    85	  · have h1 : baseChangeLift g i hcomp ≫ (ℙ(n; S') ↘ S') =
    86	        pullback.snd pi g := IsPullback.lift_snd _ _ _ _
    87	    have hsq : IsPullback (baseChangeLift g i hcomp) (pullback.fst pi g)
    88	        (ProjectiveSpace.map n g) i := by
    89	      have hbig : IsPullback
    90	          (baseChangeLift g i hcomp ≫ (ℙ(n; S') ↘ S'))
    91	          (pullback.fst pi g) g (i ≫ (ℙ(n; S) ↘ S)) := by
    92	        rw [h1, hcomp]
    93	        exact (IsPullback.of_hasPullback pi g).flip
    94	      exact IsPullback.of_right hbig
    95	        (IsPullback.lift_fst _ _ _ _)
    96	        (ProjectiveSpace.isPullback_map n g).flip
    97	    exact MorphismProperty.of_isPullback hsq.flip hi
    98	  · exact IsPullback.lift_snd _ _ _ _
    99

    10	/-!
    11	# Projective coordinates from two aligned Laurent charts
    12	
    13	This file turns the aligned generators produced by
    14	TwoChart.exists_uniform_twisted_generators into homogeneous coordinate
    15	families. For a positive twist d, it adjoins every degree-d base monomial:
    16	
    17	* 1, x, ..., x^d on the first chart;
    18	* y^d, ..., y, 1 on the second chart.
    19	
    20	If t * u = 1 on the overlap and the extra generators satisfy
    21	rho0 (aa i) = t^d * rho1 (bb i), then the complete coordinate families
    22	differ by the common unit t^d. Consequently their normalized affine-chart
    23	maps into the integral Proj agree on the overlap. These are the algebraic
    24	coordinates used to globalize a finite map to the projective line.
    25	-/
    26	
    27	set_option autoImplicit false
    28	
    29	universe u
    30	
    31	open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry
    32	
    33	namespace AlgebraicJacobian.TwoChart.TwistedCoordinates
    34	
    35	variable {I R0 R1 R01 : Type u}
    36	  [CommRing R0] [CommRing R1] [CommRing R01]
    37	
    38	/-- The degree-d base monomials followed by the aligned generators on the
    39	x-chart. -/
    40	def chart0 (d : ℕ) (x : R0) (aa : I → R0) :
    41	    Fin (d + 1) ⊕ I → R0
    42	  | Sum.inl r => x ^ (r : ℕ)
    43	  | Sum.inr i => aa i
    44	
    45	/-- The same degree-d base monomials in reverse order, followed by the
    46	aligned generators on the y-chart. -/
    47	def chart1 (d : ℕ) (y : R1) (bb : I → R1) :
    48	    Fin (d + 1) ⊕ I → R1
    49	  | Sum.inl r => y ^ (d - (r : ℕ))
    50	  | Sum.inr i => bb i
    51	
    52	@[simp]
    53	theorem chart0_inl (d : ℕ) (x : R0) (aa : I → R0)
    54	    (r : Fin (d + 1)) :
    55	    chart0 d x aa (Sum.inl r) = x ^ (r : ℕ) := rfl
    56	
    57	@[simp]
    58	theorem chart0_inr (d : ℕ) (x : R0) (aa : I → R0) (i : I) :
    59	    chart0 d x aa (Sum.inr i) = aa i := rfl
    60	
    61	@[simp]
    62	theorem chart1_inl (d : ℕ) (y : R1) (bb : I → R1)
    63	    (r : Fin (d + 1)) :
    64	    chart1 d y bb (Sum.inl r) = y ^ (d - (r : ℕ)) := rfl
    65	
    66	@[simp]
    67	theorem chart1_inr (d : ℕ) (y : R1) (bb : I → R1) (i : I) :
    68	    chart1 d y bb (Sum.inr i) = bb i := rfl
    69	
    70	/-- The first family is normalized at the degree-d monomial X0^d. -/
    71	@[simp]
    72	theorem chart0_zero (d : ℕ) (x : R0) (aa : I → R0) :
    73	    chart0 d x aa (Sum.inl ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ d⟩) = 1 := by
    74	  simp
    75	
    76	/-- The second family is normalized at the degree-d monomial X1^d. -/
    77	@[simp]
    78	theorem chart1_last (d : ℕ) (y : R1) (bb : I → R1) :
    79	    chart1 d y bb (Sum.inl ⟨d, Nat.lt_succ_self d⟩) = 1 := by
    80	  simp
    81	
    82	/-- A positive twist ensures that the first family contains the base
    83	coordinate x itself, not just the two endpoint monomials. -/
    84	@[simp]
    85	theorem chart0_one (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (x : R0) (aa : I → R0) :
    86	    chart0 d x aa (Sum.inl ⟨1, Nat.succ_lt_succ hd⟩) = x := by
    87	  simp
    88	
    89	/-- A positive twist ensures that the second family contains the base
    90	coordinate `y` itself. -/
    91	@[simp]
    92	theorem chart1_one (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (y : R1) (bb : I → R1) :
    93	    chart1 d y bb (Sum.inl ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩) = y := by
    94	  change y ^ (d - (d - 1)) = y
    95	  rw [show d - (d - 1) = 1 by omega, pow_one]
    96	
    97	/-- The complete chart families differ by the common factor rho0 x ^ d on
    98	the overlap. The base-monomial case is the identity
    99	t^r = t^d * u^(d-r) following from t * u = 1. -/
   100	theorem map_chart (rho0 : R0 →+* R01) (rho1 : R1 →+* R01)
   101	    (x : R0) (y : R1) (htu : rho0 x * rho1 y = 1)
   102	    (d : ℕ) (aa : I → R0) (bb : I → R1)
   103	    (hab : ∀ i, rho0 (aa i) = rho0 x ^ d * rho1 (bb i)) :
   104	    ∀ j, rho0 (chart0 d x aa j) =
   105	      rho0 x ^ d * rho1 (chart1 d y bb j) := by
   106	  rintro (r | i)
   107	  · simp only [chart0_inl, chart1_inl, map_pow]
   108	    have hr : (r : ℕ) + (d - (r : ℕ)) = d :=
   109	      Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp r.isLt)
   110	    calc
   111	      rho0 x ^ (r : ℕ) =
   112	          rho0 x ^ (r : ℕ) * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
   113	      _ = rho0 x ^ (r : ℕ) *
   114	          (rho0 x * rho1 y) ^ (d - (r : ℕ)) := by
   115	        rw [htu, one_pow]
   116	      _ = rho0 x ^ (r : ℕ) *
   117	          (rho0 x ^ (d - (r : ℕ)) * rho1 y ^ (d - (r : ℕ))) := by
   118	        rw [mul_pow]
   119	      _ = rho0 x ^ d * rho1 y ^ (d - (r : ℕ)) := by
   120	        rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, hr]
   121	  · simpa only [chart0_inr, chart1_inr] using hab i
   122	
   123	/-- The common transition factor is a unit, together with the coordinate
   124	scaling identity it controls. -/
   125	theorem map_chart_unit (rho0 : R0 →+* R01) (rho1 : R1 →+* R01)
   126	    (x : R0) (y : R1) (htu : rho0 x * rho1 y = 1)
   127	    (d : ℕ) (aa : I → R0) (bb : I → R1)
   128	    (hab : ∀ i, rho0 (aa i) = rho0 x ^ d * rho1 (bb i)) :
   129	    IsUnit (rho0 x ^ d) ∧
   130	      ∀ j, rho0 (chart0 d x aa j) =
   131	        rho0 x ^ d * rho1 (chart1 d y bb j) :=
   132	  ⟨(IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one _ htu).pow d,
   133	    map_chart rho0 rho1 x y htu d aa bb hab⟩
   134	
   135	/-- Enlarging a spanning family by the degree-d base monomials preserves
   136	spanning on the first chart. -/
   137	theorem span_chart0 {A : Type u} [Semiring A] [Module A R0]
   138	    (d : ℕ) (x : R0) (aa : I → R0)
   139	    (hspan : Submodule.span A (Set.range aa) = ⊤) :
   140	    Submodule.span A (Set.range (chart0 d x aa)) = ⊤ := by

   142	  rw [← hspan]
   143	  apply Submodule.span_mono
   144	  rintro z ⟨i, rfl⟩
   145	  exact ⟨Sum.inr i, rfl⟩
   146	
   147	/-- Enlarging a spanning family by the degree-d base monomials preserves
   148	spanning on the second chart. -/
   149	theorem span_chart1 {A : Type u} [Semiring A] [Module A R1]
   150	    (d : ℕ) (y : R1) (bb : I → R1)
   151	    (hspan : Submodule.span A (Set.range bb) = ⊤) :
   152	    Submodule.span A (Set.range (chart1 d y bb)) = ⊤ := by
   153	  apply top_unique
   154	  rw [← hspan]
   155	  apply Submodule.span_mono
   156	  rintro z ⟨i, rfl⟩
   157	  exact ⟨Sum.inr i, rfl⟩

   159	private lemma adjoin_singleton_eq_top_of_span_pow_eq_top

   174	    {A B I : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]

namespace affineChartAt

/-- Inclusion of the arbitrary standard chart into relative projective
space. -/
def incl : affineChartAt J i S ⟶ ℙ(J; S) :=
  pullback.fst (toProjInt J S)
    (Proj.awayι P[J] (X i) (X_i_mem_deg_one J i) Nat.zero_lt_one)

instance : IsOpenImmersion (incl J i S) := by
  dsimp [incl]
  exact MorphismProperty.pullback_fst _ _
    (Proj.instIsOpenImmersionAwayι P[J] (X i)
      (X_i_mem_deg_one J i) Nat.zero_lt_one)

/-- The chart inclusion followed by the integral projection is the other
pullback projection followed by the integral chart inclusion. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem incl_toProjInt :
    incl J i S ≫ toProjInt J S =
      pullback.snd (toProjInt J S)
          (Proj.awayι P[J] (X i) (X_i_mem_deg_one J i) Nat.zero_lt_one) ≫
        Proj.awayι P[J] (X i) (X_i_mem_deg_one J i) Nat.zero_lt_one :=
  pullback.condition

instance : (affineChartAt J i S).CanonicallyOver S where
  hom := incl J i S ≫ (ℙ(J; S) ↘ S)

@[simp]
theorem over_eq : affineChartAt J i S ↘ S = incl J i S ≫ (ℙ(J; S) ↘ S) :=
  rfl

/-- The arbitrary chart is the inverse image of `D_+(X_i)` under the integral
projection. -/
theorem opensRange_incl :
    (incl J i S).opensRange =
      toProjInt J S ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen P[J] (X i) := by
  change (pullback.fst (toProjInt J S)
      (Proj.awayι P[J] (X i) (X_i_mem_deg_one J i) Nat.zero_lt_one)).opensRange = _
  rw [Scheme.Hom.opensRange_pullbackFst, Proj.opensRange_awayι]

section IsoAffineSpace

variable [Finite J]

/-- On integral models, the spectrum of the arbitrary chart ring is affine
space on the complementary coordinates. -/
def specAwayIso :
    Spec (.of (Away P[J] (X i))) ≅
      Spec (.of (MvPolynomial {j : J // j ≠ i} (ULift.{u} ℤ))) :=
  (Scheme.Spec.mapIso
    (((AffineChartAtRing.awayAlgEquiv (ULift.{u} ℤ) J i).toRingEquiv
      .toCommRingCatIso).op)).symm

private def integralChartIncl :
    Spec (.of (Away P[J] (X i))) ⟶ Proj P[J] :=
  Proj.awayι P[J] (X i) (X_i_mem_deg_one J i) Nat.zero_lt_one

private def flattenIso :
    affineChartAt J i S ≅
      pullback (terminal.from S)
        (integralChartIncl J i ≫ terminal.from (Proj P[J])) :=
  pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso
    (terminal.from S) (terminal.from (Proj P[J])) (integralChartIncl J i)

private def changeChartHom :
    pullback (terminal.from S)
        (integralChartIncl J i ≫ terminal.from (Proj P[J])) ⟶
      𝔸({j : J // j ≠ i}; S) :=
  pullback.map
    (terminal.from S)
    (integralChartIncl J i ≫ terminal.from (Proj P[J]))
    (terminal.from S)
    (terminal.from
      (Spec (.of (MvPolynomial {j : J // j ≠ i} (ULift.{u} ℤ)))))
    (𝟙 S) (specAwayIso J i).hom (𝟙 (⊤_ Scheme)) (by simp) (by simp)

private instance : IsIso (changeChartHom J i S) := by
  dsimp [changeChartHom]
  apply pullback.map_isIso

@[reassoc]
private theorem changeChartHom_over :
    changeChartHom J i S ≫ (𝔸({j : J // j ≠ i}; S) ↘ S) =
      pullback.fst (terminal.from S)
        (integralChartIncl J i ≫ terminal.from (Proj P[J])) := by
  change pullback.lift _ _ _ ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = _
  rw [pullback.lift_fst, Category.comp_id]

omit [Finite J] in
@[reassoc]
private theorem flattenIso_hom_over :
    (flattenIso J i S).hom ≫
        pullback.fst (terminal.from S)
          (integralChartIncl J i ≫ terminal.from (Proj P[J])) =
      pullback.fst (ProjectiveSpace.toProjInt J S) (integralChartIncl J i) ≫
        (ℙ(J; S) ↘ S) :=
  pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso_hom_fst _ _ _

/-- The relative standard chart `D_+(X_i)` is affine space on all coordinates
other than `i`. -/
def isoAffineSpace :
    affineChartAt J i S ≅ 𝔸({j : J // j ≠ i}; S) :=
  flattenIso J i S ≪≫ asIso (changeChartHom J i S)

@[reassoc]
theorem isoAffineSpace_hom_over :
    (isoAffineSpace J i S).hom ≫ (𝔸({j : J // j ≠ i}; S) ↘ S) =
      affineChartAt J i S ↘ S := by
  change ((flattenIso J i S ≪≫ asIso (changeChartHom J i S)).hom) ≫
      (𝔸({j : J // j ≠ i}; S) ↘ S) = affineChartAt J i S ↘ S
  rw [Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc, asIso_hom, changeChartHom_over,
    flattenIso_hom_over]
  rfl

end IsoAffineSpace

section IsoAffineSpace

variable [Finite J]

/-- On integral models, the spectrum of the arbitrary chart ring is affine
space on the complementary coordinates. -/
def specAwayIso :
    Spec (.of (Away P[J] (X i))) ≅
      Spec (.of (MvPolynomial {j : J // j ≠ i} (ULift.{u} ℤ))) :=
  (Scheme.Spec.mapIso
    (((AffineChartAtRing.awayAlgEquiv (ULift.{u} ℤ) J i).toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso).op)).symm

private def integralChartIncl :
    Spec (.of (Away P[J] (X i))) ⟶ Proj P[J] :=
  Proj.awayι P[J] (X i) (X_i_mem_deg_one J i) Nat.zero_lt_one

private def flattenIso :
    affineChartAt J i S ≅
      pullback (terminal.from S)
        (integralChartIncl J i ≫ terminal.from (Proj P[J])) :=
  pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso
    (terminal.from S) (terminal.from (Proj P[J])) (integralChartIncl J i)

private def changeChartHom :
    pullback (terminal.from S)
        (integralChartIncl J i ≫ terminal.from (Proj P[J])) ⟶
      𝔸({j : J // j ≠ i}; S) :=
  pullback.map
    (terminal.from S)
    (integralChartIncl J i ≫ terminal.from (Proj P[J]))
    (terminal.from S)
    (terminal.from
      (Spec (.of (MvPolynomial {j : J // j ≠ i} (ULift.{u} ℤ)))))
    (𝟙 S) (specAwayIso J i).hom (𝟙 (⊤_ Scheme)) (by simp) (by simp)

private instance : IsIso (changeChartHom J i S) := by
  dsimp [changeChartHom]
  apply pullback.map_isIso

@[reassoc]
private theorem changeChartHom_over :
    changeChartHom J i S ≫ (𝔸({j : J // j ≠ i}; S) ↘ S) =
      pullback.fst (terminal.from S)
        (integralChartIncl J i ≫ terminal.from (Proj P[J])) := by
  change pullback.lift _ _ _ ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = _
  rw [pullback.lift_fst, Category.comp_id]

omit [Finite J] in
@[reassoc]
private theorem flattenIso_hom_over :
    (flattenIso J i S).hom ≫
        pullback.fst (terminal.from S)
          (integralChartIncl J i ≫ terminal.from (Proj P[J])) =
      pullback.fst (ProjectiveSpace.toProjInt J S) (integralChartIncl J i) ≫
        (ℙ(J; S) ↘ S) :=
  pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso_hom_fst _ _ _

/-- The relative standard chart `D_+(X_i)` is affine space on all coordinates
other than `i`. -/
def isoAffineSpace :
    affineChartAt J i S ≅ 𝔸({j : J // j ≠ i}; S) :=
  flattenIso J i S ≪≫ asIso (changeChartHom J i S)

@[reassoc]
theorem isoAffineSpace_hom_over :
    (isoAffineSpace J i S).hom ≫ (𝔸({j : J // j ≠ i}; S) ↘ S) =
      affineChartAt J i S ↘ S := by
  change ((flattenIso J i S ≪≫ asIso (changeChartHom J i S)).hom) ≫
      (𝔸({j : J // j ≠ i}; S) ↘ S) = affineChartAt J i S ↘ S
  rw [Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc, asIso_hom, changeChartHom_over,
    flattenIso_hom_over]
  rfl

end IsoAffineSpace

end affineChartAt
